# Privacy Banner Builder

Privacy Banner Builder is a static visual builder for consent banner copy, required-service disclosures, optional plugin configuration, JSON validation, and live preview.

## Key URLs

- Builder: https://privacy.js.gripe/
- Demo: https://privacy.js.gripe/demo.html
- Loader: https://privacy.js.gripe/privacy-plugin-loader.js
- Default config: https://privacy.js.gripe/privacy-plugins.json
- Stylesheet: https://privacy.js.gripe/privacy-plugin-banner.css

## Notes for AI Agents

- Required services should be limited to site operation, security, session continuity, language preferences, and privacy-choice storage.
- Optional plugins should load only after consent and should not include secrets or provider tokens in public JSON.
- The builder validates public configuration and previews the banner UI in real time.
